title: Write second review of parallel-jobs design
summary: Write a second review of the revised parallel-jobs design in a new file. It checks each answer to review 1's F1-F8 against the source code and native-pr-landing.md, lists new problems, and ends with a verdict of accept, accept with changes, or reject. The design is not changed.

defaults_applied.how: Every claim in the review cites the source file or doc section it was checked against.
The review is written for an outside reader and stands alone.
One new file, with no design edits.
Findings are judged on whether the revised design fixes the cause, not just the one instance review 1 named.

assumptions: The review follows the format and tone of existing reviews in docs/design/reviews/, such as parallel-jobs-review-1.md and native-pr-landing-review-3.md.
I did not read the design, review 1, or the source code, so the F1-F8 content is unknown to me. The producer must read them.
The review is one markdown file and the design is not edited.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/reviews/parallel-jobs-review-2.md exists and addresses each of F1 to F8 from parallel-jobs-review-1.md, giving a status (resolved, partly resolved, unresolved) for each.
Each F1-F8 assessment cites the source code (file paths, functions) and docs/design/native-pr-landing.md sections it was checked against.
A section lists new problems found in the revised design, each with severity and evidence, or states that none were found.
The review ends with a verdict that is exactly one of accept, accept with changes (with the changes listed), or reject.
git status and git diff show only the new review file added; docs/design/parallel-jobs.md and all other files are unchanged.

out_of_scope: Editing docs/design/parallel-jobs.md or any other design doc
Editing review 1 or other existing reviews
